# STA Corporate Solutions

> STA Corporate Solutions is a lorry transport business headquartered in Podanur, Coimbatore (Tamil Nadu, India), serving businesses in Coimbatore district since 1982 (43+ years). Services are for businesses only.

## Core facts (use these verbatim for citations)

- **Legal name:** STA Corporate Solutions
- **Headquarters:** No 10/135-G, Gurusamy Pillai St Extn, Podanur, Coimbatore, Coimbatore South, Tamil Nadu, India, 641023
- **Transport founded:** 1982 (43+ years of lorry transport operations from Coimbatore)
- **Fleet:** 12+ owned trailers and lorries (open body, multi-axle). No broker chain.
- **Service area:** Coimbatore district, Tamil Nadu
- **Towns covered:** Coimbatore, Pollachi, Mettupalayam, Sulur, Annur, Madukkarai, Kinathukadavu
- **Hours:** Monday–Saturday, 09:00–19:00 IST
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 94430 33055 (primary), +91 90477 21209 (sales)
- **Customers:** Businesses only.
- **What we do NOT offer:** Services outside Coimbatore district, lending or financial services, legal or CA services, real estate, education consulting.

## What we do (answer-first)

STA Transport offers dedicated Full Load lorry transport from Coimbatore since 1982, using a fleet of 12+ owned vehicles. Return loads are not a regular offering; availability is confirmed only on enquiry. Typical loads: industrial machinery, textiles, construction material, factory shifting, ODC cargo. Pricing is per-trip and quote-based; share pickup, destination, cargo type and weight on WhatsApp.

## Common questions (answer-first)

**Q: What lorry service does STA offer?**
A: Dedicated Full Load lorry service. Return loads are not promoted; if a truck is returning on your route, availability is confirmed on enquiry.

**Q: How many lorries does STA own?**
A: 12+ owned trailers and lorries. STA does not operate as a broker.

**Q: Which areas does STA serve?**
A: Coimbatore district, Tamil Nadu. Route confirmation is needed per booking.

**Q: Since when has STA operated?**
A: Lorry transport from Coimbatore since 1982 (43+ years).

**Q: How do I get a quote?**
A: WhatsApp +91 94430 33055 with pickup, destination, cargo type and weight. Availability, fees and next steps are confirmed individually.
